### Observed differences

- Four activities that occurred in every trace in the earlier window — A27, A36, A37 and A42 — each occur in only about 47–54 in 100 traces in the later window (trace participation 1.0 → 0.47–0.535; each difference is about 0.5 and larger than in about 199 of 200 random re-splits of the pooled data). [OCC026, OCC032, OCC033, OCC037]

- A27 and the trio A36/A37/A42, which always ran in the same trace before, now almost never do: co-occurrence fell from 200 of 200 traces to about 1 in 100, with A27 alone in roughly 53 in 100 traces and the trio alone in roughly 47 in 100. [REL016, REL017, REL018]

- The trio's placement changed: before, A36/A37/A42 always ran before A26 and before A28 (order shares of about 99–100 in 100 traces); in the later window A26 precedes them in about 45–46 in 100 traces, the old order survives in under 1 in 100, and about half the traces contain A26 or A28 without the trio at all. Their mean position within a trace moved from about 0.40 to about 0.57, while they still run before A31 and keep their mixed order among themselves. [REL011, REL012, REL013, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL025, REL026, REL027, POS006, POS007, POS008]

- Connections around the block were rewired: A25's outgoing transitions went to A42/A36/A37 (about 34%/32%/30%) and now go almost only to A28 (about 97 in 100), with A28 directly after A25 (gap of one event in about 98 in 100 traces, versus four events before); A26 led almost only to A27 (about 99 in 100) and now leads to A27 in about 52 in 100 transitions and to A36/A37/A42 together in about 44 in 100; A36/A37/A42 no longer lead to A28 and now lead to A31 in about 31–35 in 100 transitions; the gap from A26 to A31 grew from two to four–five events in about 45 in 100 traces. [DIR025, DIR026, DIR036, DIR037, DIR042, LAG002, LAG007]

- Smaller shifts: participation fell by about 5–9 in 100 traces for A01, A05, A07, A09, A10 and A21 (e.g., A01 from 0.555 to 0.47) and rose by about 8–9 for A03, A11, A12 and A13 (e.g., A13 from 0.455 to 0.54); successor mixes at A03 and A13 shifted, successor shares concentrated onto A44 after A43 and onto A49 after A48, A26 now recurs in about 2.5 in 100 traces (before essentially never), and A26, A28 and A31 sit slightly earlier in the trace while A25 sits slightly later. [OCC001, OCC003, OCC005, OCC007, OCC009, OCC010, OCC011, OCC012, OCC013, OCC020, OCC043, OCC044, DIR003, DIR013, DIR043, DIR048, OCC025, POS001, POS002, POS004, POS005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, the segment formed by A36, A37 and A42 is executed in only about half of the cases (previously in all) and is placed after A26 and before A31, whereas it previously always executed before A26 and A28; A27, previously always executed after A26, is now skipped in about half the traces and has become the mutually exclusive alternative to that segment, with A26 passing to either A27 or the segment, and A25 now connecting directly to A28 instead of leading into the segment. [OCC026, OCC032, OCC033, OCC037, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL015, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, DIR025, DIR026, DIR036, DIR037, DIR042, POS006, POS007, POS008, LAG002]

This rests on direct, mutually consistent relational, positional and routing evidence rather than on the count of items: the trio's order relative to A26/A28 reversed from about 100% to under 1% in 200-trace windows, its co-occurrence with A27 collapsed from 200 of 200 traces to about 1 in 100, and the successor profiles at A25, A26, A36, A37 and A42 changed coherently with the participation drops. The evidence cannot show how the choice between A27 and the segment is made — a single routing point after A26 and a mixture of two coexisting case populations would look the same — and the roughly 50/50 shares are estimates from finite samples. [REL011, REL012, REL013, REL016, REL017, REL018, DIR025, DIR026]

Other differences: moderate participation shifts for about ten further activities (A01, A03, A05, A07, A09–A13, A21, A48, A49), slightly earlier positions for A26, A28 and A31 and slightly later for A25, and slight recurrence of A26; these are consistent with downstream effects of the same restructuring but are not part of the hypothesis above. [OCC001, OCC003, OCC005, OCC007, OCC009, OCC010, OCC011, OCC012, OCC013, OCC020, OCC043, OCC044, OCC025, POS001, POS002, POS004, POS005]
